top_stories.title: Amazon acquires key assets of AI startup Decart for reported $7.5B
top_stories.description: Amazon.com Inc. today announced plans to hire the technical staff of startup Decart.AI Inc. and acquire its core technology. The company didn’t disclose the terms of the deal. However, sources told Bloomberg that Amazon is paying about $7.5 billion. That’s nearly twice the valuation Decart reportedly received after its most recent funding round in May. top_stories.title: ByteDance Researchers Open-Sources Laminar, an Async Reinforcement Learning RL Post-Training Framework
top_stories.description: Laminar is an open-source asynchronous RL post-training framework from HKU and ByteDance Seed researchers. It decouples rollout, training and weight sync, and lifted Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B to 52.2% on SWE-bench Verified.
